scope: Native candidate-source review only; no actor or sensor creation
vehicle_inventory: One get_spawn_points call, preserve every returned transform and index
blueprint_dimensions: Frozen measured M8F asset geometry; no new Actor to measure other models
navigation_seed: NotSet; actual server-returned positions are authoritative replay evidence
navigation_orientation: Declared candidate yaw from nearest Sidewalk waypoint; preserve actual returned XY/Z and raw point; never move point to waypoint
geometry: Frozen M8F support semantics, layer separation, 0.10m lane inset, 15-point footprint, static OBB; native XY/yaw preserved; no rejection override
settled_box: Hypothetical vertical-only alignment for feasibility; never a measured final actor or authorized spawn transform
native_initial_z: Record original bottom gaps; do not freeze physics at initial pose
camera_geometry: Existing six-camera pinhole rig; frustum only, visibility/occlusion/identity NotRun
template_selection: After inventory geometry and historical preflight, one deterministic best native vehicle and one native navigation point per eligible native Ego; score only geometry, 20-40m frustum support and distance-to-30m. Greedy choose at most four Ego groups at least 50m apart, never resample or alter locations. No permutations or retry search after fixed template review.
history: Reuse immutable M8G 16562 records and full source SHA list; assert near-footprint regressions; HistoricalCoverageIncomplete; no blind Final
